data.title: The Perfect Number
data.statement:
Ian has been sleeping in class all day. His teacher walks toward him and SMACKS him in the face. Ian wakes up, flabbergasted.

The teacher says, "Since you have been asleep all day, you have one challenge. Given a positive integer N, determine whether it is a Perfect Number."

A Perfect Number is a positive integer that is equal to the sum of all its positive divisors except itself.

For example, 6 is a Perfect Number because 1 + 2 + 3 = 6.

Help Ian determine whether N is a Perfect Number.
data.outputDescription: Print "YES" if N is a Perfect Number. Otherwise, print "NO".

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Ian has been sleeping in class all day. His teacher walks toward him and SMACKS him in the face. Ian wakes up, flabbergasted.

The teacher says, "Since you have been asleep all day, you have one challenge. Given a positive integer N, determine whether it is a Perfect Number."

A Perfect Number is a positive integer that is equal to the sum of all its positive divisors except itself.

For example, 6 is a Perfect Number because 1 + 2 + 3 = 6.

Help Ian determine whether N is a Perfect Number.
Input
A single positive integer N.
Output
Print "YES" if N is a Perfect Number. Otherwise, print "NO".
Constraints
Example
Input
6
Output
YES
